config.heading: PollBuddy Settings
config.subtitle: Create quick polls in record comments. These settings apply to this app; the repository app and server are shared by every app in this domain.
config.allowNonAdminPollItem: Allow users without app management permission to create polls
config.allowNonAdminPollHelp: When off, only this app's administrators see the Poll button. Anyone who can view a record can always vote on its polls.
config.step1Help: One repository app holds the polls for every app in this domain. Create it once. If it already exists, paste its App ID below instead of creating another. Only administrators and its creator can open it, since it holds polls from every app, including ones a user can't open.
config.createRepositoryConfirm: This creates a new app in this domain to hold poll data. Only do this once per domain. If one already exists, paste its App ID instead.
config.repositoryAppDescription: Poll data for PollBuddy (意思決定くん). Read and written by the PollBuddy server; don't edit records by hand.
config.step2Title: Give the repository app an API token
config.step2Help: The server uses this token to save polls and count votes, so it needs View records, Add records, and Edit records. Keep it private: it can read every poll in this domain.
config.repositoryTokenInstructions: Next, open its API token settings and generate a token with View records, Add records, and Edit records. Click Save, then Update App. You'll paste the token in step 3.
config.openRepositoryTokenSettings: Open the repository app's API token settings
config.step3Help: Sends the repository app's API token from step 2 to this domain's server, which stores it and uses it to read and write polls. It isn't saved in Kintone, so provisioning again means pasting it again or generating a new one. Every app in this domain shares one server, and no other domain uses it.
config.repositoryTokenHelp: Paste the repository app's API token from step 2. It's sent to the server and stored there, not in Kintone.
config.serverProvisioning: Setting up this domain's server. This takes a few minutes. You can leave this page; setup keeps going and picks up here when you come back.
config.serverNotProvisioned: This domain isn't provisioned yet. Click Provision server above and paste the token from step 2.
config.step4Title: Give this app an API token
config.step4Help: The server needs View records on this app to check each poll's announcement comment and to post the results when a poll ends. The token is kept in this plugin's hidden settings, which only this app's administrators can see, and on the server.
config.appTokenInstructions: Open this app's API token settings and generate a token with View records. Click Save, then Update App. Paste the token below and click Save at the bottom of this page.
config.openThisAppTokenSettings: Open this app's API token settings
config.deleteServerHelp: Deletes this domain's server from AWS, along with the tokens it stored. Polls stop working in every app in this domain, and polls that haven't ended won't post their results. The repository app and its polls stay in Kintone, so provisioning again brings the server back, at a new address.
config.deleteServerConfirm: This deletes this domain's server. Polls stop working in every app in this domain. Paste the repository app's API token to confirm.
config.serverDeleted: Server deleted. It takes a minute or two to finish.
config.saveSuccess: The plug-in settings have been saved. Please update the app!
